asideTitle: Your data never leaves this page

faq.a: No. This tool runs entirely in your browser using JavaScript. Nothing you paste is uploaded, stored, or sent anywhere.
faq.q: Is my input sent to a server?

faq.a: Yes. The XML is parsed with the browser's strict XML parser; if the document is malformed, the tool shows the parser's error instead of output, so a successful format means the XML is well-formed.
faq.q: Does it validate as well as format?

faq.a: Yes — 2 spaces, 4 spaces, or a tab. Attributes stay on the same line as their element, matching common XML style.
faq.q: Can I choose the indent size?

whenNotToUse: Well-formed is not the same as valid — this checks XML syntax, not conformance to a specific XSD/DTD schema.
Comments and processing instructions are preserved as-is in place, but the formatter will not reformat the inside of CDATA sections or preformatted content.
